display_name: Meesho implementation — SKU-Level Return Rate
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  b.sku_id,
  b.brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_sales s ON b.order_id = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_reverse r ON b.order_id = r.order_id AND r.is_active = true
WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.sku_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.sku_id, b.brand
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) > 5
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;
